metadata.title: A Metric Extension Theorem
metadata.abstract: We show that, given a partially defined metric $d:R\rightarrow\mathbb{R}$ where $R\subset X^2$ is a closed equivalence relation on a compact metrizable space $X$, there is a metric $\hat{d}:X^2\rightarrow \mathbb{R}$ such that $d = \hat{d}|_{R}$

analysis.topic: 度量测度几何、极限与奇异空间
analysis.progressType: 闭等价关系上的度量延拓
analysis.workSummary: 证明紧可度量空间上定义于闭等价关系的部分度量可延拓为整个空间上的度量，且在原关系上精确保持。
analysis.breakthrough: 给出保持各等价类内部距离的全局延拓。
analysis.limitations: 紧致性、可度量性与关系闭性都是所述定理条件。
